security_note: This is a security fix: it is applied in the window shown either way; this notice lets you know when.
choose_window: Choose when you would like it done
window_unavailable: Already started: it cannot be chosen.
name_hint: Optional. So we know who answered.
pick_first: Choose a window to approve it.
reject_intro: Tell us why it does not suit you. With your answer we will reschedule it and send you new windows.
reason_required: Write the reason for rejecting it.
failed_title: Your answer could not be sent

approved.title: Maintenance approved
approved.body_here: You approved the maintenance: it will be done on {{window}}. A confirmation email is on its way.

auto_applied.title: Maintenance scheduled
auto_applied.body: As there was no answer, it was scheduled for {{window}}.
auto_applied.body_here: As there was no answer, it was scheduled for {{window}}.

rejected.title: Maintenance rejected
rejected.body: The request was rejected. We will send you a new proposal.
rejected.body_here: You rejected the request. We will send you a new proposal with other windows.

cancelled.title: Maintenance cancelled
cancelled.body: This maintenance was cancelled: there is nothing to answer.
cancelled.body_here: This maintenance was cancelled: there is nothing to answer.

no_response.title: Request not answered
no_response.body: This request got no answer and no window is still available. We will send you a new proposal.
no_response.body_here: This request got no answer and no window is still available. We will send you a new proposal.

answered.title: You already answered
answered.body: This request was already answered through this link.

closed.title: Request closed
closed.body: This maintenance no longer waits for an answer: someone else answered it, or it was scheduled or cancelled.

superseded.title: There is a newer request
superseded.body: We sent you a newer email about this maintenance. Use the link in that email.

expired.title: The link expired
expired.body: The link stopped working when the first window offered started.

not_found.title: Invalid link
not_found.body: This link does not match any maintenance request. Check that you copied all of it from the email.

gone.title: The link no longer answers
gone.body: This link can no longer answer the request.

invalid.title: The answer was refused
invalid.body: Check what you wrote and try again.

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: There were too many attempts from your connection. Wait a minute and try again.

network.title: No connection
network.body: We could not connect. Check your internet connection and try again.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: We could not load the request. Try again in a few minutes.

errors.window_taken: That window is no longer available (it may have started). Choose another.
